params.caption: 🎮 Overwatch's next hero leaks: Hudson, an omnic detective, joins DPS in Season 6 Associate game director Alec Dawson let slip on a stream that the hero was first planned as a support before moving to DPS, and game director Aaron Keller then named him: Hudson. Keller says Hudson scored by far the highest of any hero Blizzard has playtested, ahead of Juno.
